fields.value: Replication Data for: Co-designing educational programs for nursing home professionals based on scientific research, 2019-2020

authorAffiliation.value: Tilburg University, Tilburg School of Social and Behavioral Sciences, Tranzo, Academische Werkplaats Ouderen

dsDescriptionValue.value:
Co-designing educational programs based on scientific research findings: what have been the experienced hindering and enabling factors in the co-design process, with researchers, teachers and lecturers from different levels of care education, nurses from NH practice and an educational development expert?

A total of 66 documents of qualitative data were collected: Transcripts of audio recordings of semi-structured interviews with the co-creators at the start, halfway through, and at the end of the co-design period; reports of the monthly meetings; first author’s personal logs; photographs of summaries of discussions; two summaries of the whole trajectories; leading to creative works of participants and notes of the creative analysis.

publicationCitation.value: Muller-Schoof, I. J.M, Verbiest, M. E. A, Snoeren, M., & Luijkx, K. G. (2023). Lessons Learned from Co-Designing Educational Programs for Student and Practicing Healthcare Professionals in Nursing Homes: A Participatory Qualitative Study, Journal Of Participatory Research Methods Vol.4 (2023) Nr.1.

fields.value: Method: Qualitative participatory research, using interviews, reports, logs, photographs, summaries and creative works.

seriesInformation.value: This study is part of a PhD dissertation called "Learning and creating together: Bridging the gap between science and practice through education to enhance person-centered nursing home care."
